desc: Read N, K, and the sequence A from standard input.
Compute the total XOR of all elements in A.
Determine K_prime = min(K, N-K) to minimize the number of combinations to enumerate.
Use itertools.combinations to generate all combinations of K_prime elements from A.
For each combination, compute the XOR sum, then compute the candidate answer as total_xor ^ combination_xor, and update the maximum.
